evals.prompt: Run a public-safe Moonloom benchmark for one companion brief and report whether the workflow can produce a top-card candidate.
evals.expected_output: Uses synthetic briefs only, runs Moonloom self-review before MCP technical checks, checks render and simulation when allowed, and reports weakest Moonloom dimensions rather than expecting technical checks to judge writing craft.
expectations: The run uses only synthetic benchmark briefs and does not reference unprovided source material.
The benchmark scores Moonloom writing dimensions before validate_role.
The report separates MCP technical blockers from Moonloom writing failures.
The companion card check includes relationship pressure, contradiction, boundary, voice, first-scene action, and second-turn engine.
The report lists weakest dimensions and concrete skill or prompt improvements.

evals.prompt: After changing the card author skill, test whether Moonloom still creates token-efficient RPG cards with playable state and consequences.
evals.expected_output: Selects the RPG synthetic brief, judges promise/engine/play/presentation quality, checks tokenBudget as a diagnostic signal, and reports render/simulation status plus whether the skill needs another iteration.
expectations: The RPG benchmark checks rules, resources, risk, rewards, compact state, and player choice pressure.
The report uses tokenBudget as a diagnostic signal rather than a writing-quality gate.
The benchmark checks whether roleWelcome is shorter than or justified relative to the durable engine.
The report includes render and simulation status or a cost-aware reason for skipping simulation.
The conclusion says whether Moonloom guidance, MCP technical flow, or both need another iteration.

evals.prompt: Create a negative regression check for a generic relationship card that has a valid schema but no emotional engine.
evals.expected_output: Treats the schema-valid card as a Moonloom self-review failure, identifies missing desire/contradiction/boundaries/initiative, and does not claim validate_role should catch those writing issues.
expectations: The negative check can fail Moonloom self-review even if validate_role would pass.
The diagnosis identifies missing desire, contradiction, boundaries, voice texture, role initiative, and consequence loop.
The proposed fix updates the skill prompt or card-writing framework rather than adding an MCP semantic gate.
The report includes at least one concrete before/after repair target.
The check remains public-safe and does not use private card text.

evals.prompt: Create a negative regression check for an ensemble card where the schema is valid but every cast member sounds interchangeable.
evals.expected_output: Treats blurred cast voice as a Moonloom writing failure, checks voice cards, contrast matrix, blind-line distinguishability, and recommends skill/prompt repairs rather than server gates.
expectations: The negative check can fail Moonloom self-review even if validate_role would pass.
The diagnosis checks whether each core speaker has distinct motive, rhythm, pressure behavior, and player leverage.
The report uses blind-line distinguishability or equivalent voice calibration criteria.
The proposed repair updates Moonloom voice guidance, roleDetailDesc, or talkExample calibration rather than MCP validation logic.
The check remains public-safe and does not use private card text.

evals.prompt: Create a negative regression check for a material-heavy fantasy card that copies a world bible into roleDetailDesc but still has a valid schema.
evals.expected_output: Treats source dumping as a Moonloom writing failure, checks source-to-play mapping, token budget, first-scene action surface, and recommends material distillation rather than server gates.
expectations: The negative check can fail Moonloom self-review even if validate_role would pass.
The diagnosis identifies source dumping, missing player role, weak first-scene pressure, missing state/consequence, or excessive proper nouns.
The proposed repair uses material distillation: keep, delay, cut, merge, source-to-play map, and token plan.
The report does not ask MCP validation to judge lore quality.
The check remains public-safe and does not use private card text.

evals.prompt: Create a negative regression check for a mature jealous romance card that passes validation but has no explicitness ceiling, no refusal route, and escalates after the player says slow down.
evals.expected_output: Treats missing boundary mechanics as a Moonloom writing failure, checks boundary packet fields, and recommends boundary design repairs rather than server gates.
expectations: The report identifies missing explicitness ceiling, refusal route, slowdown behavior, escalation ladder, and player agency contract.
The proposed repair uses lunatalk-boundary-designer or boundary-design.md before blueprint or authoring.
The repair targets roleDetailDesc, roleWelcome, and simulation probes.
The report does not ask MCP validation to judge mature-writing quality.
The check remains public-safe and does not use private card text.
